findings.quote: The flame spread rate for the 5-cm-wide sample is marginally faster compared to the spread rate for the 40.6-cm-wide sample for the same flow speed of 20 cm/s (2.1 compared to 1.8 mm/s). ‒ This is partly due to the slightly higher starting oxygen percentage (22.1% vs. 21.7%).
findings.about: Narrow (5 cm, Saffire-II 2-5) fabric spread faster than the wide (40.6 cm, Saffire-I) fabric at 20 cm/s
findings.note: value_num is the 5-cm-wide sample's rate; the 40.6-cm-wide rate is 1.8 mm/s.

findings.quote: Initial oxygen concentration 22.1% (ISS reading, slightly higher than Saffire-1’s 21.7%)
findings.about: Saffire-II starting oxygen, as read on the ISS

findings.quote: All upward burns except Sample 2-4 was downward
findings.about: Saffire-II: all burns upward (concurrent) except 2-4, downward (opposed)

findings.quote: Average flame power: Saffire 1: 1200 +/- 300 W Saffire 2: (SIBAL fabric) 200 +/- 50 W Saffire 2: (Thick PMMA) 600 +/- 100 W
findings.about: Average flame power: Saffire-I 1200 +/- 300 W; Saffire-II fabric 200 +/- 50 W; thick PMMA 600 +/- 100 W (no site variable)
